# zcat

Write decompressed gzip data for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/zcat@0.1.6 [OPTION]... [FILE]...
```

## Supported scope

Decode files or stdin to stdout, retaining input files. Supports concatenated members and checksum/size verification.

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c` / `--stdout` | none | Write to stdout and keep input files. |
| `-d` / `--decompress` | none | Decompress (default for gunzip and zcat). |
| `-t` / `--test` | none | Validate compressed input without output. |
| `-n` / `--no-name` | none | Omit name/time metadata when compressing. |
| `-q` / `--quiet` | none | Suppress trailing-garbage warnings. |
| `-1` / `--fast` | none | Same as -1. |
| `-9` / `--best` | none | Same as -9. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `-2` | none | Select compression level 2; ignored when decompressing or testing. |
| `-3` | none | Select compression level 3; ignored when decompressing or testing. |
| `-4` | none | Select compression level 4; ignored when decompressing or testing. |
| `-5` | none | Select compression level 5; ignored when decompressing or testing. |
| `-6` | none | Select compression level 6; ignored when decompressing or testing. |
| `-7` | none | Select compression level 7; ignored when decompressing or testing. |
| `-8` | none | Select compression level 8; ignored when decompressing or testing. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Limitations

- Only gzip is supported; no suffix searching, force/pass-through or metadata restoration.
- Invalid input returns 1 after any decoded prefix; trailing garbage returns 2.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/zcat@0.1.6 first.gz second.gz
moonx cli/zcat@0.1.6 < first.gz
```
